d:
Israil ke chunav men chune gae sansdon ne pad ki shapath le li hai. is bich purv sena pramukh gadi aaizankot sarkar banane ke lie gathbandhan taiyar karne ki koshish kar rahe hain.
Is par bharat ki bhi nazar hai. iski bari vajah donon deshon ke gahre rishte hain. vahin, pradhanmantri narendr modi aur binyamin netanyahu ke bich dosti bhi hai.
Aise men saval hai ki agar aaizankot naee sarkar banane men saphal hote hain, to kya bharat ke sath israil ke rishton men bhi badlav aaega? aaj pahli khabar men isi ki bat.
